license_note: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 is released by Alibaba/Qwen under Apache-2.0; the unsloth GGUF re-quantization is likewise Apache-2.0. Redistribution with attribution is permitted; the GGUF is kept out of git for repo-size reasons and fetched from the pinned upstream Hugging Face revision, then checksum-verified against sha256 before it is baked into the image. The attribution text (NOTICE) ships inside the image.
source_note: The ~2.9 GB GGUF exceeds GitHub's 2 GiB release-asset limit, so — like whisper large-v2 — the image build fetches it from Hugging Face at the sha-pinned upstream_revision and verifies sha256; the weight is baked in, so end users pull ghcr.io/bengizmo/voxint-llm with no Hugging Face account, token, or network access needed.
sampling: greedy (temperature 0) — enforced client-side (SamplingProfile), not a server flag
scope: transcript enhancement + run-asset summary/entity_mentions ONLY; NOT web research or LLM speaker-name attribution (issues #66/#67)
qualification: measured against the #66 frozen corpus (tests/fixtures/llm_qual/) under the shipped enhancement prompt; see docs/gpu-contracts.md for the pinned serving profile
